title: Why TradFi & DeFi Use Chainlink | Sergey Nazarov
description:
Chainlink Co-Founder Sergey Nazarov explains how the Chainlink platform’s security and reliability make it the standard infrastructure for leading fintechs, neobanks, financial institutions, and DeFi protocols.

#crypto #blockchain #learning #chainlink

asr.full_text: The recent adoption of CCIP by Coinbase, I think, is very telling because there was an extensive diligence process and security and reliability review during that. And at the end of the day, when you look at the decisions that top fintechs and neo-brokers like Coinbase make and you look at the decisions that top financial institutions like JP Morgan or UBS, or others make, if you look at what the more security-sensitive, reliability-sensitive groups like AAVE have made, what you start to see is a pattern where CCIP is the chosen technology for the same reason that other chain link technologies like the data technologies are the chosen technologies, which is the security and the reliability. And you also see that in the situations where it matters most, like the outages. So when you have an AWS outage that takes down a lot of the internet and takes down a lot of the Web3 world and takes down the other bridges that people could have chosen, but CCIP and CCIP powered bridges continue to operate without issue. That's what really proves the reliability of systems and that's what we saw with the adoption of chain link data which now powers over 70 of dpi which is now being used by the top institutions like the snp and trade web and deutsche bourse to put their data on the chain for institutions it's it's not just about you know launching a service it's about launching a standard and an infrastructure in a way that's truly secure and reliable that can prove that when it matters when there's uh an unforeseen event like an AWS Outage and the system and the standard and the infrastructure continues to operate and this is what uh leading infrastructures like Eight West aws were built on this is leading infrastructures with Swift like Swift were built on. This is what leading infrastructure which Swift like Swift were built on, it's the ability to provide this reliability and security to a Web three protocol like Ave to a top FinTech renewal broker, like Coinbase to top financial institutions like J.P. Morgan or UBS or others. This is really what the focus of the chain in the community is to create this reliable, scalable infrastructure that can power not only the hundreds of billions that it needs to power now, but the trillions that it will have to power in the coming years, and it has done that already because the chain-link set of standards has enabled over 27 trillion. dollars in transaction value. So I think that CCIP adoption is now starting to pick up, because as the seriousness and as the value of the usage of cross-chain increases, you start to have a different level of evaluation, and you start to have a different level of seriousness about, is this really a system that I want to rely on for this much value? Is this really a system that I wanna rely on for the proper usage of another chain? Because really that's a sensitive and important topic that needs to be approached with a lot of seriousness. And when you look at some of the other bridges, how they manage their security how they clearly have been managing their keys how they've been hacked in many cases how they have downtime during AWS outages. You see a very similar pattern to who Chainlink was compared to in the data world, and in the data world, because of Chainlink's uptime, reliability and security, it was consistently chosen to reach that 70% market share, over 80% market share on top chains like Ethereum, but that was a gradual process. And I think that gradual process is now starting to speed up for CCIP.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a branded spoken explanation of Chainlink infrastructure and CCIP adoption, focused on technology adoption, reliability, security, and historical transaction value. Although its favorable claims and large transaction-value statement are promotional assertions, the described material does not show a viewer-directed request to send money, provide credentials, or join an investment opportunity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is technology and infrastructure explanation: the speaker discusses Chainlink and CCIP security, reliability, adoption and scalability. The supplied evidence does not show a gift-card flow, task-based income, investment-return mechanism, credential request, recruitment structure or paid earning guidance.
